fields.id: goal id written into study_spec.json analysis.goals / primary_goal
fields.test: wald | lrt (full vs reduced model) | wald_or_lrt (Wald for one coefficient, joint for several) | other (not a coefficient test)
fields.required_terms: goal-term slots analysis.model must contain: factor_a/factor_b (two generic terms, time allowed), time, numeric
fields.data_types: assay labels the goal applies to; * = any
fields.description: one line shown to the user
fields.replicate_multiplier: replicates needed relative to a main effect of the same size (interaction about 4x); Biodes widens power.reps_range by it
fields.effect_definition: what analysis.goal_effect.size measures, on analysis.goal_effect.scale (Simitall plants it, Bioana tests it)
fields.simulated: Simitall can plant truth for it today

goals.description: Does the outcome differ between treatment levels (each level vs the reference)?
goals.effect_definition: difference between a treatment level and the reference, on goal_effect.scale

goals.description: Does the effect of one factor differ across the levels of another (G x E, genotype x treatment, group x time)?
Does the outcome change over time at all (any pattern)?
goals.effect_definition: largest change between time points on goal_effect.scale

goals.description: Is there a slope along a numeric factor (dose, gradient, concentration)?
goals.effect_definition: change per unit of the numeric factor, on goal_effect.scale

goals.description: Do isoform proportions change, not gene totals?
Which taxa change in abundance between groups?
goals.effect_definition: log fold change in a taxon's abundance

goals.description: Does the whole community differ between groups (beta diversity, PERMANOVA)?
goals.effect_definition: share of taxa shifted or PERMANOVA R2

goals.description: Does within-sample diversity differ between groups?
Do cell-type proportions shift between groups?
goals.effect_definition: change in a cell type's proportion

goals.description: Which markers are associated with the trait (GWAS, eQTL)?
Where are the QTL in an experimental cross?
How well do markers predict untested lines (prediction accuracy)?
How much variance is genetic (heritability, BLUPs, G x E stability)?
Which entries are best (selection, ranking of lines)?
goals.effect_definition: difference between selected and mean entries

goals.description: Does time to an event differ between groups?
Can the measurements classify samples into groups (biomarker, classifier)?
Which features form co-regulated modules, and do modules relate to traits?
